traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Action meets disruption. Impulsive, risk-taking, rebellious energy, with impatience and a pull toward technology. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Accident-proneness, a temper that goes off like a shot, and unpredictable tactics that either win big or backfire fast. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.body: The deep desire to blow up a frustrating situation is rarely the same as having a viable plan for what happens on the other side. When Mars opposes Uranus, long-simmering burnout makes an abrupt exit look like freedom, risking a messy fallout that creates more problems than it solves. You may genuinely need to leave, but stage your exit with precision. Separate the immediate relief you crave from the infrastructure you still need to survive next week.
